sentences.text: THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO DIRECT THE RESPONDENTS NO.2 TO 5 FOR SENDING THE ACQUISITIN PROPOSAL OF THE LAND SY. NO.512

6 ACRES 10 GUNTAS SITUATED AT VILLAGE NARIBOL TQ: JEWARGI DIST: KALABURAGI TO APPROPRIATE AUTHORITY I.E. RESPONDENT NO.1 TO INITIATE THE ACQUISITION PROCEEDINGS AND FOR PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION AS PER THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT AND ETC.,

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.
2. The grievance of the petitioner is with regard to sending the proposal for acquiring land bearing Sy.No.512 of Naribol village, Jewargi taluk, Kalaburagi district.
It is NC: 2023:KHC-K:7472 alleged in the writ petition that the respondent-KBJNL had initiated acquisition proceedings in respect of the land in question.

3. In that view of the matter, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, respondent No.3 herein shall take decision in the matter considering the representation dated 05.12.2018 (Annexure-D) within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
4. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
